mapper.select: SELECT account_transaction_id, kb_account_id, group_user_id, round_id, transaction_type, transaction_category, amount, balance_after, idempotency_key, description, another_account_number, another_bank_name, another_name, created_at FROM account_transactions WHERE kb_account_id = #{kbAccountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, account_transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
